preconditions.description: The integers l and r are within the specified range.
The integer n is within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: max_substrings == len([x for x in substrings if l <= int(x) <= r])
postconditions.description: The maximum number of modest substrings is correctly calculated.
The result string has the correct length n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) >= l and int(x) <= r for x in substrings if x[0] != '0')
postconditions.description: All non-zero leading substrings are within the range [l, r].

postconditions.expression: result_string == min([s for s in all_possible_strings if len([x for x in substrings if l <= int(x) <= r]) == max_substrings])
postconditions.description: The result string is lexicographically smallest among those with the maximum number of modest substrings.
